Brigham Buhler joins Danny Jones to argue that doctors are barred by law from telling patients the full truth. The episode title calls him a pharma whistleblower. Buhler speaks from his work in health care and his break with the drug trade.

Buhler claims drug firms hide cures and punish doctors who step out of line. He names the rules and fears that keep doctors quiet, as he sees them. Jones asks which claims rest on paper he can show. Listeners get a sharp charge against the drug trade from a man who worked in it. The library files the talk as an archive record.

Diane Hennacy joins Danny Jones to tell how she saw a test that should not be possible. The episode title bills her as a Harvard doctor. Her tale centers on a mind test with results that broke the rules she knew.

Hennacy tells the tale in full, from the setup of the test to the score that stunned the room. She talks about what the result did to her view of the mind. Jones asks what checks were run to rule out tricks. Listeners get a quiet, strange story told by a trained mind. The library holds the talk as an archive record of her account.
